purpose: Persistent project and institutional memory for Umbrella Intelligence. These records are intended to be retrieved before future decisions and updated when validated work creates new knowledge.
write_rules: Save durable project knowledge here, not temporary chat context.
Prefer structured records that explain what was done, what was learned, what remains unresolved, and what should happen next.
Update existing project memory when new evidence changes the position; do not create contradictory duplicates without explaining the change.
Project memory should capture process as well as outcomes so future work can continue without restarting from zero.

Buildalong.purpose: Persistent memory of Buildalong's development and validation journey under Umbrella Intelligence.
Buildalong.current_stage: End-to-end product testing before real-world builder/customer testing
process: £10 payment system and secure payment gating
Builder invites trades to a job
Full end-to-end testing across Builder → Customer → Trades
Buildalong.validation_gate: Buildalong is not considered ready merely because the code deploys successfully. The complete experience must work end-to-end and then be proven with real builders and customers.
Buildalong.operating_loop: Build → test → observe failure/confusion → fix → retest → validate with real users → record learning
notes: Payment integration has required multiple rounds of debugging; payment should be treated as an end-to-end dependency, not a completed feature merely because Stripe is connected.
The customer and trades experiences are core product flows and must be tested before real-world rollout.
Future Buildalong work should retrieve this process first so development does not lose sight of the real-world validation milestone.
